name: Session browser
author: Brett
description: Every Claude Code session and every headless agent run in one live grid: agent, build, job, model, status (running, done, failed, killed for budget), tokens, dollars, duration, started. A row opens to what it built (from real commits and file edits, before / after, with an estimated price per line), its Context (everything that went in and what came back, cost per turn), Tools (every command and file edit, cost per command) and Conversation; watch a running run live and kill it. Totals and a per-model breakdown at the bottom. Reads Claude Code transcripts, headless stream logs and agent-run@1 reports; links to the Codebase changes log and the Session check-in archive.
